How do I convert square feet back to acres?
Divide by 43,560. A 30,000 sq ft lot is 0.6887 acres — the direction listings less often show, and the one buyers need.
Is an acre the same everywhere?
The international acre (43,560 sq ft) is the standard. Historical local acres existed (the Scottish and Irish acres were larger); modern US and UK usage is the international figure.
When should I quote square feet instead of acres?
Below about half an acre, square feet read clearer and compare faster; above a few acres, feet become noise. Listings choose the unit that flatters — converters choose the one that informs.
Can I use this for service-area planning?
Only as unit translation: a service area measured in the Map Radius Tool can be expressed in either unit through this factor. The area itself comes from the map, not from a conversion.
How many square feet is a football field?
An American football field including end zones is 57,600 sq ft — which is 57,600 ÷ 43,560 ≈ 1.32 acres. It is the comparison that makes an acre imaginable.
What is half an acre in square feet?
Exactly 21,780 sq ft — the lot size behind a large share of US suburban listings, and a number worth recognising on sight.
